lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you. My name is Zhang Wei.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 工作过，我在一家公司上过班。
lines.pinyin: Gōngzuò guo, wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī shàng guo bān.
lines.en: Yes, I worked at a company.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, wǒ zuò chē shàngbān.
lines.en: Not far, I take the bus to work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 很好。你喜欢这个工作吗？
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Nǐ xǐhuan zhège gōngzuò ma?
lines.en: Good. Do you like this job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 很喜欢，我希望能在这儿工作。
lines.pinyin: Hěn xǐhuan, wǒ xīwàng néng zài zhèr gōngzuò.
lines.en: I like it a lot, I hope I can work here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 那太好了。我们下星期给你打电话。
lines.pinyin: Nà tài hǎo le. Wǒmen xià xīngqī gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: Great. We'll call you next week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ děng nǐ de diànhuà.
lines.en: Thank you, I'll wait for your call.
